empty: No priced call in this session yet.
unavailable: The cost ledger is not reachable from this session.
money.mixed: this session mixes {currencies}; totals are not summed
column.scope.title: A turn row holds the turn total; click a row to expand or collapse its steps
column.model.title: the provider and model that priced this call, with the pricing mode, region and tier the ledger recorded
column.files.title: the files this call touched, each pill dot carrying its stage tone; a call that touched no file shows its token count
column.tokens.title: input + cache read + cache write + output tokens of the call
column.cache.title: cache read / (input + cache read + cache write): the share of the prompt the cache served
column.cacheRead.title: the money the cache-read tokens cost; the light bar segment
column.input.title: the money the uncached input tokens cost; the primary bar segment
column.output.title: the money the output tokens cost; the warm bar segment
column.other.title: the total minus cache read, input and output: cache writes, reasoning and any remainder; the neutral bar segment
column.allocation.title: the direct cost the touched bytes paid, then the amortized context cost spread over the call's files
column.total.title: the total cost split: light cache read, blue input, orange output, gray cache write and reasoning. Bar length uses a square-root scale; steps compare only with the steps of the same turn, turns with turns
turn.label: Turn {turn}
turn.toggle.title: Expand or collapse the steps of this turn
step.label: Step {step}
step.toggle.aria: Expand or collapse the file details of step {step}
step.started.title: Step started at {time}
detail.title: Click this row to expand or collapse the file details
state.unpriced.title: the ledger recorded no price row for this call, so its money is whatever the ledger stored
state.failed.title: the call recorded error code {code}
state.attempts.title: {count} attempts ran before the settled message
state.cacheMiss.title: the cache served less than half of the prompt tokens
files.title: {calls} calls: {files}
files.saving.title: the net cache benefit against the uncached input rate
saving.negative.title: a negative figure is cache-write overhead: the cache-write premium outweighed the cache-read saving
detail.allocationOnly: context allocation only; not touched in this call
detail.touchedNoDetail: touched, but no change detail recorded
totals.session.title: every call this session recorded in the ledger, not only the rows loaded here
topFiles.label: Top files
topFiles.title: the files with the largest allocated cost in this session
topFiles.empty: No file carries an allocated cost yet.
overview.title: Session overview
overview.tokens.title: input + cache read + cache write + output tokens over every call of this session
overview.cost.title: the money this session recorded in the ledger for every call
files.column.file.title: the file this conversation touched; the full path is in the tooltip
files.column.touches.title: {touches} touches: {reads} reads, {edits} edits, {writes} writes, {searches} searches; first {first}, last {last}
files.column.lines.title: {added} lines added, {removed} lines removed; {bytesAdded} bytes in, {bytesRemoved} bytes out
files.column.lifetime.title: every conversation's allocation to this file
files.column.before.title: the lifetime cost this conversation inherited: lifetime minus this conversation
files.column.conversation.title: this conversation's allocation to the file: direct plus amortized
files.column.turn.title: what the last turn of this conversation spent on the file
files.column.share.title: this conversation's share of the file's lifetime cost
files.column.stage.title: the first stage the file reached, and how many stages it reached in all
files.column.verdict.title: the outcome the ledger recorded for this file in this session
files.contributions.title: Conversations that paid for this file
files.contributions.empty: No conversation contributed to this file.
files.empty: This conversation has not touched a file yet.
contributions.title: File contributions
contributions.hint: one file, its conversations, and the calls that paid for it
contributions.idle: Enter a file path to read the conversations that paid for it.
contributions.empty: No conversation allocated money to this file.
contributions.column.calls.title: the calls of this conversation that allocated money to the file
contributions.column.share.title: this conversation's share of the file's lifetime cost
contributions.calls.title: Calls that paid for this file
contributions.calls.empty: This conversation recorded no call for this file.
contributions.call.column.scope.title: the turn and step of the call; the tooltip names when it started
contributions.call.column.tokens.title: input + cache read + cache write + output tokens of the call
contributions.call.tokens.title: input {input}, output {output}, cache read {cacheRead}, cache write {cacheWrite}
contributions.call.column.stage.title: the stage the file reached in this call; a call that only carried the file recorded no touch and no stage
contributions.call.column.evidence.title: whether this call touched the file or only carried it in its context
contributions.evidence.touched.title: this call touched the file, so it paid the file's direct share
contributions.evidence.carry.title: this call only carried the file in its context, so it paid the amortized share
valuation.label: Cost basis
valuation.title: the same recorded usage revalued against catalog revision {revision} under attribution policy {policy}
pricing.title: Pricing settings
pricing.notice: Editing rates changes calculated costs. It does not change recorded usage, providers, conversations, or file changes.
pricing.empty: This ledger carries no pricing catalog yet.
pricing.revisions.empty: This catalog carries no published revision yet.
pricing.rates.empty: This revision carries no rate row.
pricing.rate.unit: rates are per 1,000,000 tokens, one currency per row
pricing.problem.moment: {field} must be a date such as 2026-01-15 10:30.
pricing.problem.order: The valid-until instant must be after the valid-from instant.
pricing.problem.reason: Say why this revision exists before publishing.
pricing.problem.empty: This revision carries no rate row to publish.
pricing.problem.revision: Choose a catalog and a published revision first.
pricing.preview.pending: Available after publish: the draft has no published revision yet.
pricing.preview.noSession: Select a conversation to preview this revision's impact.
pricing.preview.unpriced.title: the calls revision {revision} could not price: no rate row, or a rate in another currency; a missing rate is unpriced and never a zero
pricing.preview.title: the same recorded usage revalued under revision {revision}
pricing.column.input.title: the money one million uncached input tokens cost
pricing.column.output.title: the money one million output tokens cost
pricing.column.cacheRead.title: the money one million cache-read tokens cost; a dash is a bucket the book does not separately price
pricing.column.cacheWrite.title: the money one million cache-write tokens cost; a dash is a bucket the book does not separately price
pricing.column.reasoning.title: the money one million reasoning tokens cost; a dash is a bucket the book does not separately price
pricing.column.validFrom.title: the instant this rate starts applying to usage; the interval is half-open
pricing.column.validTo.title: the instant this rate stops applying to usage; a dash is an open end
pricing.column.tierFrom.title: the token count this tier starts at; the bands tile the axis so no token is priced twice
pricing.column.tierTo.title: the token count this tier ends at; a dash is the open top tier
